evidence.ACL: Chronic high-grade tear of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: extensive complex tearing of the remnant meniscus and maceration of the body.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Inner margin tearing of the body and anterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis, most advanced in the medial compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: High-grade chondrosis with superimposed full-thickness fissuring at the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau with large marginal spurs.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis with superimposed full-thickness fissuring, most prominent at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea, and large marginal spurs.
